name: Loom
description: Supervises another app's automated decisions: every item Anvil's triager decides gets a case, an agent judges whether the decision was defensible, and anything nobody settles before its deadline raises a notification.

features.name: Autonomous review
features.description: An agent judges each decision and says why it agrees or disputes

features.name: Review deadlines
features.description: A case nobody settles in time lapses instead of going quiet

features.name: Push back to Anvil
features.description: A disputed decision is flagged upstream so a human sees it again

features.name: Notify through Dispatch
features.description: Raise an escalated or lapsed case to a person

free.name: Free
free.description: New cases stop when the free cases are used; the ones already open keep being supervised.
